evidence.quote: This year, the big four AI hyperscalers plan to spend around $650 billion on data center capital expenditures .
evidence.one_line: Big four AI hyperscalers plan about $650 billion of data center capex this year (2026).
evidence.speaker: fool.com analyst

evidence.quote: Next year, Nvidia claims this group will spend more than $1 trillion.

evidence.quote: Microsoft will provide investors with fiscal year (FY) 2027 capital expenditures guidance, and a huge jump over last year's figure could confirm the bull case behind Nvidia's stock.
evidence.one_line: Author expects Microsoft to give FY2027 capex guidance in July; a large jump would confirm the bull case.
evidence.speaker: fool.com analyst
